abilities.name: Breach Atlas
abilities.text: Once per round, after you enter or clear a movement/anomaly sector, record a private route insight.

abilities.name: Ghost Mile
abilities.text: Descriptive only. A failed movement or route test leaves Senna with a revised route insight for a later decision.

abilities.name: Surveyor's Cut
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a route Contract, set its progress to at least 1.

abilities.name: Rift Script
abilities.text: Descriptive only. After a clean Signal or Guile read, Senna shares route intelligence with the sector.
